review.why: Builds Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the 1.0 preview: a gate on the package line, a contract of non-negotiable behaviors and a map to current docs.
review.summary: First checks that the dependency and image are on the preview line and hands off to the stable or migration skill otherwise. The contract: exec takes an argv list and returns a handle when the process starts, no implicit shell or stdin, local wait timeouts do not kill the process, ids belong to the current container, and secrets stay in the Worker.
strengths: Gate prevents mixing preview and stable APIs
Contract lists easy-to-miss behaviors such as wait timeouts not killing processes
Credentials stay in the Worker, not the sandbox
cautions: Quick reference and examples are not read here
